import json, math, sys
BASE='/home/user/crypto/research/curve25519_t10_winner_ecbench_20261104/ecbench'
NONOP={'residual_table_bytes_uncharged','factor_base_vec_bytes_floor_uncharged','native_table_bytes_uncharged'}
W=[0.0,0.1,1.0]
WIN='pkm-iso-t5-g4-s1307'
recs=[]
for c in range(16):
    for l in open(f'{BASE}/chunks/c{c:02d}/records.jsonl'):
        r=json.loads(l); r['_chunk']=c; recs.append(r)
assert len(recs)==160
assert all(not r['warmup'] for r in recs)
assert all(r['outcome']['status']=='verified' for r in recs)
assert all(r['cost']['total_gae'] is not None for r in recs)
rs={r['workload']['curve']['r'] for r in recs}; assert rs=={131203}, rs
SQ=math.sqrt(131203)
out={'sqrt_r':SQ}
def unpriced_ops(r):
    tot=0; missing=[]
    for name in r['cost']['unpriced']:
        if name in NONOP: continue
        base=name[:-len('_uncharged')] if name.endswith('_uncharged') else name
        if name in r['counters']: tot+=r['counters'][name]; continue
        found=False; sub=0
        for p in r['phases']:
            nat=p.get('native') or {}
            if name in nat: sub+=nat[name]; found=True
            elif base in nat: sub+=nat[base]; found=True
        if found: tot+=sub; continue
        if base.startswith('solver_') and r.get('solver'): tot+=r['solver']['ops']; continue
        missing.append(name)
    return tot, missing
for r in recs:
    r['_G']=r['cost']['total_gae']; r['_U'],miss=unpriced_ops(r)
    assert not miss,(r['arm'],miss)
    assert abs(r['cost']['s']-r['_G']/SQ)<1e-9
def S(r,w): return (r['_G']+w*r['_U'])/SQ
arms=sorted({r['arm'] for r in recs})
band=json.load(open(f'{BASE}/band_pooled.json'))
brow={x['arm']:x for x in band['rows']}
print('=== per-arm mean S (mine) vs band_pooled.json ===')
mine={}
for a in arms:
    rr=[r for r in recs if r['arm']==a]
    means=[sum(S(r,w) for r in rr)/len(rr) for w in W]
    cs=sum(r['_G'] for r in rr); ns=sum(r['_U'] for r in rr)
    mine[a]={'runs':len(rr),'mean_s':means,'charged_sum':cs,'native_sum':ns}
    b=brow[a]
    rel=[abs(m/x-1) for m,x in zip(means,b['mean_s'])]
    print(f"{a:22s} n={len(rr)} mean_s={['%.6f'%m for m in means]} charged={cs} native={ns} | band: {['%.6f'%x for x in b['mean_s']]} charged={b['charged_sum']} native={b['native_sum']} maxrel={max(rel):.2e} sums_eq={cs==b['charged_sum'] and ns==b['native_sum']}")
out['band_rows']=mine
# ranks
print('=== band ranks (mine) ===')
ranks=[]
for i,a in enumerate(arms):
    for b in arms[i+1:]:
        ma,mb=mine[a]['mean_s'],mine[b]['mean_s']
        lt=all(x<y for x,y in zip(ma,mb)); gt=all(x>y for x,y in zip(ma,mb))
        v=f'{a} < {b}' if lt else (f'{b} < {a}' if gt else 'unresolved inside the band')
        ranks.append({'a':a,'b':b,'verdict':v})
bv={(x['a'],x['b']):x['verdict'] for x in band['ranks']}
for x in ranks:
    print(f"{x['a']} vs {x['b']}: {x['verdict']}  | band file: {bv.get((x['a'],x['b']))}  match={bv.get((x['a'],x['b']))==x['verdict']}")
out['ranks']=ranks
# t quantile by numeric integration of the Student-t density (own code)
def t_pdf(t,nu):
    return math.exp(math.lgamma((nu+1)/2)-math.lgamma(nu/2))/math.sqrt(nu*math.pi)*(1+t*t/nu)**(-(nu+1)/2)
def t_cdf_half(x,nu,n=20000):  # integral 0..x by Simpson
    h=x/n; s=t_pdf(0,nu)+t_pdf(x,nu)
    for i in range(1,n): s+=(4 if i%2 else 2)*t_pdf(i*h,nu)
    return s*h/3
def t975(nu):
    lo,hi=0.0,10.0
    for _ in range(80):
        mid=(lo+hi)/2
        if t_cdf_half(mid,nu)<0.475: lo=mid
        else: hi=mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
T15=t975(15); print('t_0.975(15) =',T15, '(reference 2.1314495)')
out['t975_df15']=T15
# paired compare
print('=== paired ratios winner / comparator ===')
pc=[json.loads(l) for l in open(f'{BASE}/pooled_compare.jsonl')]
pcm={(x['a'],x['weight']):x for x in pc}
paired={}
for A in ['pkm-iso-t6-g4','pkm-iso-t6-g4-s1308','proj-a','rho-neg']:
    ia={(r['workload']['workload_id'],r['round']):r for r in recs if r['arm']==A}
    ib={(r['workload']['workload_id'],r['round']):r for r in recs if r['arm']==WIN}
    keys=sorted(set(ia)&set(ib)); assert len(keys)==32
    for w in W:
        cl={}
        for k in keys:
            cl.setdefault(k[0],[0.0,0.0]); cl[k[0]][0]+=S(ia[k],w); cl[k[0]][1]+=S(ib[k],w)
        Ak=[v[0] for v in cl.values()]; Bk=[v[1] for v in cl.values()]; K=len(Ak); assert K==16
        sa=sum(Ak); R=sum(Bk)/sa
        u=[(b-R*a)/sa for a,b in zip(Ak,Bk)]; ub=sum(u)/K
        se=math.sqrt(K/(K-1)*sum((x-ub)**2 for x in u))
        half=T15*se/R; lo,hi=R*math.exp(-half),R*math.exp(half)
        wins=sum(1 for a,b in zip(Ak,Bk) if b<a)
        pairwins=sum(1 for k in keys if S(ib[k],w)<S(ia[k],w))
        ref=pcm[(A,w)]
        d=max(abs(R/ref['ratio']-1),abs(lo/ref['ci95'][0]-1),abs(hi/ref['ci95'][1]-1))
        paired[f'{A}@{w}']={'ratio':R,'ci95':[lo,hi],'wins_targets':wins,'wins_pairs':pairwins,'K':K,'pairs':len(keys)}
        print(f"{A:22s} w={w:<4} R={R:.6g} CI=[{lo:.6g},{hi:.6g}] wins(targets)={wins}/16 wins(pairs)={pairwins}/32 | file R={ref['ratio']:.6g} CI={['%.6g'%x for x in ref['ci95']]} wins_b={ref['wins_b']} maxrel={d:.1e}")
out['paired']=paired
# charged search
SEARCH=6935271; Ss=SEARCH/SQ
print('=== charged search ===', 'S_search=',Ss)
cs={}
for i,w in enumerate(W):
    amort=mine[WIN]['mean_s'][i]; charged=amort+Ss; s0=mine['pkm-iso-t6-g4']['mean_s'][i]
    cs[str(w)]={'amortised':amort,'charged':charged,'ratio_to_seed0_charged':charged/s0,'ratio_to_seed0_amortised':amort/s0}
    print(f"w={w}: amortised {amort:.6g}  charged {charged:.6g}  charged/seed0 {charged/s0:.4f}")
out['charged_search']=cs; out['search_group_ops']=SEARCH
# distances
m=mine; dist={}
for i,w in enumerate(W):
    dist[str(w)]={'rho_over_winner':m[WIN]['mean_s'][i]/m['rho-neg']['mean_s'][i],'proja_over_winner':m[WIN]['mean_s'][i]/m['proj-a']['mean_s'][i]}
    print(f"w={w}: winner behind rho-neg by {dist[str(w)]['rho_over_winner']:.6g}x, behind proj-a by {dist[str(w)]['proja_over_winner']:.6g}x")
out['distance']=dist
# model comparison
r01=paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4@0.1']['ratio']; r11=paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4-s1308@0.1']['ratio']; r10=paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4-s1308@0.0']['ratio']
model={'seed0_w01':1/18.65,'s1308_w01':1/9.28,'seed0_w0':(22/210)/(25/172),'s1308_w0':(22/210)/(36/498)}
print('=== vs T10 model ===', {k:round(v,4) for k,v in model.items()})
print(f"measured/model: seed0 w0.1 {r01/model['seed0_w01']:.3f}; s1308 w0.1 {r11/model['s1308_w01']:.3f}; s1308 w0 {r10/model['s1308_w0']:.3f}; 1/ratio seed0 {1/r01:.2f}x, s1308 {1/r11:.2f}x")
out['model']=model
# F4 per trial, columns
print('=== F4 mul-adds per trial and columns per PKM arm ===')
f4={}
for a in arms:
    rr=[r for r in recs if r['arm']==a]
    if rr[0]['solver'] is None: continue
    ops=sum(r['solver']['ops'] for r in rr); trials=sum(r['counters']['targets_tried'] for r in rr)
    cols={r['factor_base']['columns'] for r in rr}; rel=sum(r['counters']['relations_found'] for r in rr)
    f4[a]={'ops_per_trial':ops/trials,'columns':sorted(cols),'trials_per_relation':trials/rel,'solver_ops_share_of_native':ops/mine[a]['native_sum']}
    print(a, {k:(round(v,4) if isinstance(v,float) else v) for k,v in f4[a].items()})
out['f4']=f4
# Q verdicts
q={}
q['Q1_winner_verified']=f"{sum(1 for r in recs if r['arm']==WIN and r['outcome']['status']=='verified')}/32"
p2=[paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4@0.1'],paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4@1.0']]
q['Q2']=all(x['ratio']<=0.15 and x['ci95'][1]<1 for x in p2)
p3=[paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4-s1308@0.1'],paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4-s1308@1.0']]
q['Q3']=all(x['ratio']<=0.25 and x['ci95'][1]<1 for x in p3)
q['Q4']=paired['pkm-iso-t6-g4-s1308@0.0']['ratio']>=1.2
pk=[a for a in arms if a.startswith('pkm')]
q['Q5']=all(mine[a]['mean_s'][i]>mine[ref]['mean_s'][i] for a in pk for ref in ['proj-a','rho-neg'] for i in (1,2))
q['Q5_full_band']=all(mine[a]['mean_s'][i]>mine[ref]['mean_s'][i] for a in pk for ref in ['proj-a','rho-neg'] for i in (0,1,2))
print('=== Q verdicts ===', q)
out['Q']=q
# curve arithmetic
p,a,b=1048573,63700,872826; G=(349837,122); R=131203
assert (4*a**3+27*b**2)%p!=0
def isprime(n): return n>1 and all(n%d for d in range(2,int(n**0.5)+1))
assert isprime(p) and isprime(R) and 8*R==1049624
def on(P): return P is None or (P[1]*P[1]-(P[0]**3+a*P[0]+b))%p==0
def add(P,Q):
    if P is None: return Q
    if Q is None: return P
    if P[0]==Q[0] and (P[1]+Q[1])%p==0: return None
    if P==Q: l=(3*P[0]*P[0]+a)*pow(2*P[1],-1,p)%p
    else: l=(Q[1]-P[1])*pow(Q[0]-P[0],-1,p)%p
    x=(l*l-P[0]-Q[0])%p; return (x,(l*(P[0]-x)-P[1])%p)
def mul(k,P):
    Rr=None
    while k:
        if k&1: Rr=add(Rr,P)
        P=add(P,P); k>>=1
    return Rr
assert on(G) and mul(R,G) is None and mul(1,G)==G
ok=0; bad=[]; bychunk={}
for r in recs:
    T=(int(r['workload']['target'][0],16),int(r['workload']['target'][1],16)); d=int(r['outcome']['recovered'])
    good=on(T) and mul(R,T) is None and 0<=d<R and mul(d,T and G)==T
    good=on(T) and mul(R,T) is None and 0<=d<R and mul(d,G)==T
    ok+=good; bad.append(r['record_id']) if not good else None
